jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / modular game sprite extraction.
INPUT image is the EXACT portrait approved by the user. Extract a transparent modular hair layer faithfully from THIS image, matching its fine muted grey-brown charcoal hair strands and delicate low-contrast gongbi rendering.

The original eyes at approximately x460/568,y366 and chinx518,y541 are invisible registration guides only, not objects to paint.
The target is a single independent production hair layer used with the existing separate face, eyebrows, eyes, mouth, robe and complementary hair layer. Output HAIR ONLY with native transparency. All skin, forehead, ears, eyebrows, eyes, nose, lips, face, neck, clothing, embroidery, paper background, lighting halo, cast skin shadows and unrelated pixels must be completely absent/transparent. Hair edges must retain delicate semi-transparent strands with clean alpha, no beige matte, no colored silhouette halo, no large foggy low-alpha smear.
Do not redesign, recolor, darken, sharpen or make hair glossy. Preserve source's muted fine painted strands and all distinct visible shape. Fill ONLY the concealed HAIR support needed for this layer behind the separate face; use the same fine texture. No part labels, no grid, no comparison.
FRONT hair layer only: the softly swept-back top scalp hair/crown from about x335..680,y130..435, original natural forehead hairline around y267, fine temple/ear-front wisps. Keep forehead/face opening transparent. EXCLUDE the low coil/bun visible at viewer-left nape (around x370..435,y430..520), and all hair behind head or ears. No long hair on either shoulder. Include no bun, ponytail, tie or hairpin.
